sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the narrow irrigation channels that run between white stepped tea terraces: clear teal water in stone-lined channels, its surface drawn with a few calm flowing pen lines along the current, a pale line of light along each edge, small ripples where the water drops over a lip, the stone lip wet and darker, a little cream foam gathered at the corners, a faint reflection of the white steps. Three panels side by side: a large swatch of the channel seen from above; terraces with many channels seen from a walker's height with a small figure for scale; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, edge lights staying, flow lines and ripples gone far. Calm and readable, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, teal, white stone, cream and a touch of leaf green, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, fish, boats.
